ranked.headline: Null-model scoring of multi-element structure in spatial and regulatory single-cell data
ranked.summary: Explicit null-model tests are now applied beyond pairwise links to multi-way co-localization and enhancer hub structure.

ranked.headline: Machine learning predicts peptide, enzyme, and drug properties under stricter evaluation
ranked.summary: February 2026 preprints and publications benchmark property predictors against standardized splits, curated datasets, and experimental ADME reference data.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biological embeddings are benchmarked against simpler baselines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether pretrained protein, transcriptomic, and histology models outperform simpler embeddings on task benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Learned models forecast single-cell state trajectories and perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints shift single-cell modeling from static prediction toward forecasting and benchmarked simulation.

ranked.headline: Learned models map tissue domains and cell niches from spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Multiplexed imaging and spatial transcriptomics now support learned models linking cell interactions and genomic relationships to tissue architecture.

ranked.headline: Molecular QTL and GWAS integration links noncoding variants to genes and disease
ranked.summary: Diverse-ancestry xQTL and GWAS datasets now support gene-level and causal inference from noncoding variants toward therapeutic target prioritization.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models advance nanobody folding and biomolecular structure prediction
ranked.summary: Lightweight predictors and genomic and protein language models now report speed or accuracy gains over larger baselines.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide data resolve ancestry, admixture and archaic introgression effects
ranked.summary: Dense genome-wide and single-cell datasets now enable ancestry inference and regulatory mapping across diverse human and canine populations.

ranked.headline: Pretrained encoders now predict binding residues, interaction maps and ligand affinity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair large pretrained encoders with residue-level or generalizable outputs for protein and ligand binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Scalable genotype inference for pooled single-cell and biobank-scale genetic data
ranked.summary: Pooled and biobank-scale sequencing datasets demand inference methods that trade little accuracy for lower runtime and memory.

ranked.headline: Generative diffusion models now sample biomolecular conformations and dynamics
ranked.summary: Diffusion-based generators now target cryo-EM density, all-atom MD trajectories, and conformational ensembles, not only static structures.

ranked.headline: Haplotype, chromatin, and clonal structure inform cancer genome inference
ranked.summary: Single-cell and cell-free DNA measurements are now paired with inference that encodes haplotype, chromatin, or clonal evolutionary structure.

ranked.headline: Learned models and explicit error control reshape mass-spectrometry omics analysis
ranked.summary: Identification and quantitation in mass-spectrometry omics increasingly depend on computational modelling rather than acquisition alone.

ranked.headline: Open tools unify, annotate and query biochemical and omics data without bespoke code
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one publication target annotation, integration and interpretation across metabolomics, gene ontology and biochemical data.

ranked.headline: Error control in RNA-seq meta-analysis, spatial differential testing and batch effects
ranked.summary: Long-read and single-cell RNA-seq expand isoform and artifact resolution, while meta-analysis and spatial DE tests demand stricter error control.

ranked.headline: Machine learning maps noncoding and epigenomic regulatory features across diseases
ranked.summary: Computational inference of regulatory state now scores Alzheimer's noncoding variants and predicts histone marks and RNA methylation sites from sequence.

ranked.headline: Local platforms structure omics outputs and metadata for reproducible reuse
ranked.summary: Locally deployable frameworks now store and package sequencing, plant multi-omics, and metagenomics results with their metadata for reuse.

ranked.headline: Feature-based tools turn genomic and microbiome data into quantitative inference
ranked.summary: Recent tools extend motif-based and compositional modeling into population-genetic and microbiome-based inference.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links lineage-specific gene evolution to traits across animals
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale assemblies and synteny-aware or distance-based comparisons now link gene content changes to traits in myxozoans, Hydra, ants and turtles.

ranked.headline: Computational methods extract dynamic, spatial and assembly features from structural data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool extend structural analysis to megacomplex assembly, MD trajectories, and cryo-ET particles.

ranked.headline: Modular simulation, LLM documentation auditing and privacy-preserving data access tools
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply LLM agents to bioinformatics documentation quality while new platforms address scalable simulation and privacy-preserving data access.

ranked.headline: Models link cell mechanics, polarity and pattern formation in collective behavior
ranked.summary: Recent February 2026 models probe how mechanics and cell-cell alignment govern collective invasion and tissue polarity.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised learning reshapes biomedical image representation and enhancement
ranked.summary: Four new preprints apply learned representations to glioblastoma MRI, melanoma atlas registration, synthetic pretraining, and expansion microscopy.

ranked.headline: Explicit error and haplotype models for sequencing and viral genome inference
ranked.summary: Sequencing-error and variant-calling models are now estimated directly from reads rather than treated as fixed preprocessing steps.

ranked.headline: Automated tools quantify dynamic cell boundaries, filopodia and sperm trajectories
ranked.summary: Three February 2026 items describe open tools that automate tracking and quantification in dynamic microscopy data.

ranked.headline: Workflows and databases link microbial sequencing data to taxonomy and activity
ranked.summary: Four recent releases pair microbial sequence data with activity, viral, and resistance inference in reproducible frameworks.

ranked.headline: Circuit constraints shape balanced states and latent dynamics in simulated networks
ranked.summary: Recent work links synaptic depression, latent-manifold embeddings, and graph-based inference to how connectivity constrains simulated neural activity.

ranked.headline: Learned and geometric encodings reframe protein sequence and structure search
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply language model embeddings, alignment spectra and motif geometry to protein design and structure analysis tasks.

ranked.headline: Harmonized atlases coupled to ML ranking and perturbation models for target discovery
ranked.summary: Harmonized multi-study data now pairs directly with ML ranking and network models to nominate aging, senescence, and disease targets.

ranked.headline: Computational prioritization and design of small molecules and de novo proteins
ranked.summary: Structure-aware computational workflows now carry predictions through to synthesis, assay, and interpretable screening of TDP-43 and P-gp.

ranked.headline: Compressed feature spaces are used to classify and curate cryo-EM particle images
ranked.summary: AlignPCA-2D benchmarks PCA-reduced Euclidean alignment for 2D cryo-EM classification against RELION in a February 2026 preprint.

ranked.headline: Reduced-cost algorithms for phylogenetic placement and sequence-to-graph alignment
ranked.summary: Splicer reports sub-linear phylogenetic placement, and Theseus reports faster optimal sequence-to-graph alignment than SPOA, POASTA and abPOA.

ranked.headline: Computational models predict antigenic change and pathogen-linked immune signatures
ranked.summary: Large sequence, genome, and TCR repertoire datasets now support inference of antigenic change, resistance architecture, and SARS-CoV-2 exposure biomarkers.

ranked.headline: ML models for isomiR-aware target prediction and artificial miRNA design
ranked.summary: Machine learning now drives both microRNA target prediction with isomiR awareness and the design of artificial miRNAs for gene silencing.

ranked.headline: Latent-variable generative models are being used to explain V1 contextual modulation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend variational autoencoders to V1 contextual modulation and metabolic costs, alongside a published ventral pathway learning model.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve membrane binding, RNA delivery, and PET hydrolysis energetics
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained, atomistic, and QM/MM simulations now quantify specific free-energy states in membrane and enzymatic systems.

ranked.headline: Supervised models infer latent molecular and temporal states from high-dimensional data
ranked.summary: Learned models now infer post-mortem interval and circadian time from routine metabolomic and single-sample data, making validation the central concern.

ranked.headline: Variant effect data and gene-level models are refining variant significance calls
ranked.summary: Scalable calibration, mechanistic mutation typing, and gene-disease prediction now address clinical interpretation of variants across genes and diseases.

ranked.headline: Models infer pathogen resistance and infection traits from sequence-derived variants
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair variant-level features with interpretable models and rapid nanopore resistance calling for pathogen phenotype prediction.

ranked.headline: LLM agents grounded in scRNA-seq data and tools for single-cell annotation and reasoning
ranked.summary: LLM agents now reason over raw scRNA-seq data and Cell Ontology resources, with recent preprints reporting zero-shot annotation gains.
